what_happened.line: The School Committee took no votes; it heard three draft policies on fingerprinting, CORI and school lunch debt for early feedback.
The policies will be posted online for comment without a formal vote, with a first reading expected at the next meeting.
The superintendent called the school lunch account deficit large and unacceptable; the draft policy adds interest and collection steps for overdue balances.
Under the fingerprint draft, new employees bear the cost of the check; who pays for volunteer or chaperone checks was left unresolved.
The committee honored seven retirees, heard the MSBA board approved the revised building plan, and heard school improvement plans; Turkey Hill's returns in November.

why_it_matters: The lunch policy would let the district add interest and collection steps to unpaid school lunch balances, which could affect families with overdue accounts.
The fingerprint draft leaves open whether volunteers and chaperones would pay for their own background checks, which could affect who is willing to help with school activities.
watch_next: First reading of the three draft policies, expected at the next School Committee meeting.
Turkey Hill improvement plan, to be revisited in November with updated data.
